messages:
Anna L.: quick ping — legal flagged retention when a customer flips 'debug logs' in the console. do we have a clear policy for route-level opt-in vs account-wide consent?
Sam O.: I answered briefly in the ticket but we need an engineering path. main question: do we persist request bodies (even redacted) for debug mode?
Anna L.: they want a default of short retention + opt-in longer retention with explicit customer consent. also want to know what 'redacted' actually means for embeddings and user ids.
Mike P.: my preference: keep full raw for 24h, redacted/hashed for 30d if consent not provided, and then purge. if consent given, keep 365d. but need to be careful with embeddings — we can't store raw user PII embedded.
Kevin C.: +1 on hashed ids. also suggest we store a provenance tag instead of raw ids: e.g., `uid_hash:v2` so we can rotate hashing algo.
Sam O.: does anyone object to adding a route-level toggle in the console: Debug logs -> retention policy dropdown (24h / 30d redacted / 365d consented)?
Mike P.: UX sounds fine. Implementation notes: logging service needs an attest flag so downstream analytics know whether data is redacted or consented. otherwise mixing will be painful.
Anna L.: can we make sampling part of this? debug logs can overload our retention budget. maybe `debug` routes are sampled 5% by default unless consented.
Kevin C.: we discussed deterministic sampling earlier. I still want deterministic hashing on request_id so we can consistently sample a given user across retries. avoids bias.
Sam O.: agree. rough config sketch for the runtime (for ops/infra):
```
logging_config:
  route: "/v1/chat"
  debug_enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.05
  retention_mode: "redacted_30d"
  uid_hash_version: "v2"
  annotate_provenance: true
```
Mike P.: couple of edge cases: 1) attachments with PDFs — we should never store raw attachments unless consented. 2) function call arguments may contain PII, need per-tool redaction rules.
Anna L.: noted. Kevin — can you write a short spec for hash rotation and how provenance tags should look? Legal needs to review.
Kevin C.: will do. I'll include the rotation window and a migration plan (old_tag -> new_tag mapping).
Sam O.: devops: can we add a console warning when someone enables >30d retention without a legal attestation? maybe a checkbox: "I confirm I have customer consent".
dev-bot: deploy scheduled: logging-service v2.8 -> staging at 03:00 UTC (changes include sample-rate param and provenance flag). :white_check_mark:
Anna L.: perfect — let's sync after Kevin's spec. thanks all. :raised_hands:
